decisive_items: Angiotensin-converting enzyme level was elevated at 77 U/L
response.rationale: Diffuse non-caseating microgranulomas in GI biopsies plus elevated ACE and hepatosplenomegaly are most consistent with sarcoidosis. Crohn's disease can cause GI granulomas and symptoms but does not explain the elevated ACE as specifically; Whipple and celiac are excluded by negative specific testing.

rejected.why: Tropheryma whipplei testing was negative and Whipple disease is not characterized by non-caseating microgranulomas.
Anti-transglutaminase and anti-endomysial antibodies were negative, and celiac disease does not typically produce non-caseating microgranulomas.
